Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when a char is passed to the constructor of StringBuffer or StringBuilder. The ASCII value of the char is taken as the initial capacity, which can lead to an unexpectedly large buffer size.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases testShowBug1 and testShowBug2 trigger the bug because they instantiate StringBuffer and StringBuilder with a char. The ASCII value of 'c' is used as initial capacity, leading to a capacity of 99 instead of the expected 17.
